{
  "name": "prompt-dialect",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Underlines mistakes in your prompt as you type, fixes them with a click, and rewrites the prompt for the Claude model you are using.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Marcelo Masahiko Miyake"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/marcelomiyake/prompt-dialect",
  "repository": "https://github.com/marcelomiyake/prompt-dialect",
  "license": "MIT",
  "icon": "./icon.png",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "claude-code-plugin",
    "claude-code-mod",
    "grammar",
    "grammar-checker",
    "spelling",
    "spell-check",
    "prompt",
    "prompt-engineering",
    "prompt-improver",
    "prompt-optimizer",
    "anthropic",
    "claude"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "checkAsYouType": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Check as you type",
      "description": "Check the prompt for mistakes whenever you pause typing. /dialect on|off overrides it.",
      "default": true
    },
    "grammarModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Grammar model",
      "description": "The model that checks the prompt: a fast, cheap one. An alias such as haiku or a full model id.",
      "default": "claude-haiku-5-5"
    },
    "improvementModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Rewrite model",
      "description": "The model that rewrites the prompt for the session's model when you press Improve.",
      "default": "claude-haiku-5-5"
    },
    "debounceMs": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Pause before checking (ms)",
      "description": "How long you pause typing before the prompt is checked, from 250 to 10000.",
      "default": 900
    }
  }
}
